body.name: Second-order full-fiber lifting handle
body.construction: Apply \(H_{\mathrm{pair\mbox{-}lift}}\): solve each finite minimax threshold problem between \(\mathcal F_-(u,\delta)\) and \(\mathcal F_+(u,\delta)\); retain its sample-level least-favorable mixture; extract and localize the first nonzero second-order Hoeffding projection into public microcells; normalize occupied cells by realized ordered-pair counts as in \(S_{\mathrm{pair}}\); stabilize only the residual higher-order term; and aggregate the resulting target-indexed scores through \(\mathfrak W_r\).
